48.original: Trades<hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>, eh? You've that look about you. Interested in putting those skills of yours to use undertaking a leve or two?

49.original: It's all above board─all handled under the auspices of the Crystal Exarch, worry not. We process and dole out a mountain of leves every day. Register with us and you can peruse the open ones at your leisure.

50.original: You'll be compensated too, in case you were afraid we were running some sort of charity. So─shall I put your name down in the ledger?

51.original: Right, then! <hex:022903EB0203>, was it? Let me just finish filling out this remaining bit of paperwork, and then you'll be all set!

53.original: You may now undertake Crystarium leves by speaking with Eirikur.

54.original: You dabble in trades? Could've fooled me. Are you sure?

56.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 70 or above.
